title: He said: "Thank you, Dirk. But he doesn't even call. …
text:
He said: "Thank you, Dirk. But he doesn't even call. … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS He said: "Thank you, Dirk. But he doesn't even call. …
 HoopsHype Nov. 7, 2026, 4:03 a.m. ET Doncic was in action for the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday night, beating the Portland Trail Blazers 124-118 in the NBA Cup. Nowitzki, on the other hand, was a pundit on NBA On Prime and gave his old teammate the 'Hot Playa' nod in the pre-game show. Doncic was told about this, and the Lakers superstar thanked him before exposing him for not giving him a call since moving to Los Angeles. He said: "Thank you, Dirk. But he doesn't even call. He's in LA, he doesn't even call no more. So, I'm expecting that dinner soon. I expect that call."
